def test_workspace_copy_matches_builtin(): """The workspace copy must stay in sync with the built-in profile.
Byte equality is *not* the contract. When a profile is saved the application serializes the loaded ``Profile`` back to ``.codx/profiles``, so the workspace copy also carries the fields resolved at load time (``path``, ``user``, ``guardrails``, ``effort_name``, ``project_id``) and is written without the trailing newline.
